name: Alpha Animals
author: Sarg Bjornson, AFriend
description: Adds multiple unique new animals to Rimworld. <size=24>Features</size> Adds 100+ new, vanilla-friendly creatures to the diverse biomes of your Rimworlds. The philosophy of this mod is that every new creatures tries to bring some new mechanic into the game, whether it be walking tanks, living resource farm, indestructible plant monsters, night-time stalkers, or plain speedy giant spiders. Some of the mechanics are simple, others much more complex. These animals will spawn in certain biomes, some others will only be available via traders. You'll have to explore to find them all! The Alpha Biomes is a companion mod that adds several new alien biomes to house these weird creatures. Bear in mind that spawn probabilities have been calculated with no other animal mods installed. If you have, for example, Vanilla Animals Expanded, less animals from this mod will appear, obviously. The mod will also add new insects in a new faction, the Black Hive. Raids from that faction can be disabled via Mod Options. <size=24>Issues</size> There shouldn't be any. Balance is obviously always a concern, although it has been playtested. Feel free to tell me if you think something is too wacky. <size=24>Plans for the future</size> Obviously, more animals! <size=24>Compatibility</size> Compatible with the implants from Vanilla Genetics Expanded Compatible with Alpha Biomes (duh) Compatible with Advanced Biomes Compatible with Rainbeau Realistic Planets Compatible with Lords of the Rims - Elves (mallorn biome) <size=24>Credit</size> Original creature graphics: A_Friend, aka SentientLine Alternate "cute" animal textures by Roidgy Original implementation and programming: milon, Skullywag and kaptain_kavern Some sounds by Mike Koenig at http://soundbible.com Some sounds by PsychoBird at http://soundbible.com Some sounds by Stephan Schutze at http://soundbible.com Some animal sounds by LiamG_SFX, wisslgisse, M4D3R0 and roubignolle at https://freesound.org Fireball Graphic created by StarsteelGaming at OpenGameArt.org (2018) <size=24>Changelog</size> Full changelog on GitHub

Now a rifle with a grenade launcher will look like it has one! - Adds weapon tweaking kits that allow you to modify and change unique weapons - Adds a LOT of mod options to tweak your unique weapon experience.

name: Alpha Biomes
author: Sarg
description: Adds multiple unique new biomes to Rimworld. <size=24>Features</size> Adds 12 new diverse biomes to your Rimworlds. The mod has been designed with the Alpha Animals mod in mind, although it is not a requirement. - The Mycotic Jungle: a warm and humid biome filled with HUGE mushrooms. Home to the Wildpod and some weird mushroom varieties of usual creatures. - The Gallatross Graveyard: an arid temperate biome, littered with the skeletal remains of ancient beasts. - The Feralisk Infested Jungle: a warm, wet biome with incredibly dense vegetation, filled to the brink with extremely dangerous predatory spiders. - The Ocular Forest: a weird transdimensional realm intruding upon our Universe. Home to strange new flora and fauna. - The Gelatinous Superorganism: a swampy biome that is actually the upper surface of an extraordinarily large mold-like creature. No rocks to be found, but plenty of food. - The Mechanoid Intrusion: a desolate temperate biome with mechanical ruins. Apparently an ancient mechanoid attempt at turning the planet into a megastructure. - The Propane Lakes: a frozen wasteland, colder than the most inhospitable Sea Ice, but teaming with aberrant flora and fauna. - The Forsaken Crags: permanently clouded by a preternatural darkness, light is the most valuable commodity in this desertic landscape. Inspired by (and compatible with) the Forsakens mod. - The Tar Pits: an arid biome rich in vegetation, filled with treacherous tar pits that make movement quite difficult. Beware the Bumbledrone hives! - The Pyroclastic Conflagration: a volcanic expanse of unrelenting and brutal nature. Fire and lava are both your worst enemy and your best friend in this biome. - The Idyllic Meadows: a lush meadow of giant flowers. A super easy biome that provides tons of resources and few predators. - The Miasmic Mangrove: a dangerous tropical biome full of debilitating diseases. The biomes have been tweaked so they don't take too much space in the world map, and you might have to generate a planet again if some biome is not appearing, since they have different temperature and humidity characteristics. <size=24>Issues</size> Balance is obviously always a concern, although it has been playtested. Feel free to tell me if you think something is too wacky. <size=24>Plans for the future</size> Maybe more biomes, who knows! <size=24>Compatibility</size> Compatible with any other biome mod Compatible with Alpha Animals (obviously) Compatible with Magical Menagerie Compatible with Dinosauria Compatible with Megafauna Compatible with Vanilla Animals Expanded Compatible with Rim of Madness - Bones Compatible with Vanilla Fishing Expanded (adds 19 new fish) Compatible with Fish Industry Compatible with Forsakens Compatible with Camouflage and Stealth Compatible with Fertile Fields Mods that modify the way the world is generated MAY cause some weird results. Use at your own risk. <size=24>Credit</size> Bone planet: Hyptosis https://opengameart.org/content/bone-planet Some sounds by Mike Koenig at http://soundbible.com Alien planet sound modified from Speedenza: https://freesound.org/people/Speedenza/sounds/198532/ <size=24>Changelog</size> Full changelog on GitHub

name: Alien Worlds - Arctic
author: azey7f
description: Ocean worlds of liquid ammonia, calling these planets "freezing cold" would be an understatement. Temperatures are between negative 60-120°C planetwide, and no true solid ground exists as the only landmasses are scattered chunks upheld by ammonia cold enough to be frozen solid. This is for all the sea ice fans out there. Alpha Biomes not required, but recommended for its Propane Lakes. This mod is a planet type for the Alien Worlds Framework, check its workshop page for FAQs. Worldbuilder-compatible, but also works standalone. Source code: https://codeberg.org/azey/rw-arctic-world

name: Alien Worlds - Dreamworld
author: azey7f
description: Rumored to have been created by << dead / sleeping / dreaming >> archotechs, these worlds are a marvel to behold. Pink meadows blend seamlessly with low-hanging rose-colored clouds, while vibrant plants and fantastical creatures create landscapes straight out of a fairytale. This planet is perfect. Almost too perfect. This mod is a planet type for the Alien Worlds Framework, check its workshop page for FAQs. Worldbuilder-compatible, but also works standalone. Source code: https://codeberg.org/azey/rw-dreamworld

name: Alien Worlds - Gloomworld
author: FEB
description: This world is enveloped in thick clouds of geothermally produced smoke. As a result, almost no visible light reaches the surface. Local life has adapted to these conditions by commonly evoving bioluminescence and chemophagy. Remnants of the cultivated Earth-like biosphere linger on islands floating high above the clouds. A planet type mod for the Alien Worlds framework.

name: Alien Worlds - Hellworld
author: azey7f
description: Molten, volcanic worlds with oceans of lava and heat far beyond what baseline humans can endure. Expect real temperatures of around 70-110°C planetwide. Nearly nothing can grow or live on the surfaces of these planets, and attempting to establish a colony on one unprepared is nothing short of a suicide mission. This mod is a planet type for the Alien Worlds Framework, check its workshop page for FAQs. Worldbuilder-compatible, but also works standalone. Source code: https://codeberg.org/azey/rw-hellworld

name: Alien Worlds - Nightworld
author: azey7f
description: Planets with dark, extremely thick atmospheres that allow practically no light to reach the surface, but still orbiting at the right distance from their home star to harbor liquid water. Despite the complete lack of sunlight, some plants and even animals adapted to living in the dark seem to be thriving here. This mod is a planet type for the Alien Worlds Framework, check its workshop page for FAQs. Worldbuilder-compatible, but also works standalone. Source code: https://codeberg.org/azey/rw-nightworld

name: Alien Worlds - Tidally Locked
author: azey7f
description: Worlds of extremes whose rotational periods perfectly match their orbital periods. On these planets, the sun never sets and never rises. Their night side is extremely cold due to the complete lack of sunlight, but there is usually a habitable sliver of land on their day side. This mod is a planet type for the Alien Worlds Framework, check its workshop page for FAQs. Worldbuilder-compatible, but also works standalone. Source code: https://codeberg.org/azey/rw-tidally-locked-world

name: Alien Worlds - Toxic
author: azey7f
description: Worlds destroyed by pollution, chemical or nuclear warfare, but still inhabitable at a low level with sufficient technology. Entirely covered by ruins of a civilization long gone, scorching deserts, and oceans of toxic water. Disease and scaria run rampant, but temperatures are within the habitable range and their atmospheres could often still be considered "breathable" to a certain degree. This mod is a planet type for the Alien Worlds Framework, check its workshop page for FAQs. Worldbuilder-compatible, but also works standalone. Source code: https://codeberg.org/azey/rw-toxic-world

name: Foxes Aren't Suicidal(continued)
author: Thundercraft
description: This uses an xpath patch to reduce the {maxPreyBodySize} of foxes, preventing them from preying on humans (such as your colonists) or large animals. For the sake of realism, it also changes the {foodType} to make them omnivores and opportunistic egg-eaters instead of strict carnivores. It breaks my suspension of disbelief that the foxes in RimWorld will prey on humans. In real life, their diet consists primarily of small creatures like insects, rodents, birds and, when available, eggs. We never hear of man-eating foxes because there aren't any. Foxes would not survive as a species if they readily attacked humans or animals bigger than themselves. Credits: Special thanks to NoImageAvailable for the idea.

name: Megafauna
author: Spino, Sarg
description: <size=20>Description</size> Thanks to the wonders of today's technology, the small group of scientists that was previously known for bringing the Megatherium- Uh, I mean, the Megasloth back to life, was able to make the Megafauna Project a reality! This time around, they were able to recreate 38 different species of animals that used to inhabit planet Earth thousands to millions years ago. ...Was that a wise move? Who cares! Now we all can feast our eyes on those glorious beasts as they will slowly inevitably turn all the ecosystems we know upside-down! <size=20>Features</size> 38 new species of animals, all able to spawn naturally in different biomes: These animals are quite rare, and should be a good challenge to either tame or slay. A lot of them can also be used as pack animals for a caravan (with paraceratherium being your new best caravan buddy!). Wooly mammoth, elasmotherium, and josephoartigasia are shearable, and arthropleura, titanis, titanoboa, megalania, dinornis, quinkana, megalochelys, palaeeudyptes, gigantophis, meganeura, and purussaurus do lay eggs. Sivatherium, macrauchenia, aurochs cows, and uintatherium are milkable - sivatherium's milk is very nutritious and quite valuable! Megafauna will automatically detect and patch both A Dog Said... by SpoonShortage and Giddy-up! by Roolo, so make sure to make it load after those mods. <size=20>Languages</size> English, Polish <size=20>Credits</size> Roolo - for great help with making Megafauna compatible with his Giddy-up mod. name: Animal Traits System
author: Luved
description: Animal Traits System - Core Framework I think every animal has something unique about it if you pay enough attention. Gone are the days when every muffalo, chicken, or bear was identical. The Animal Traits System brings individuality to nearly every creature on the Rim. It gives you a reason to explore and find unique animals with the perfect combination of traits. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ What is this? It's a framework that provides a trait assignment system with modders and users being able to configure the traits. Each trait uses RimWorld's capacity and stat modifier system to create mechanically meaningful differences. You can give animals abilities, modifiers and everything else that comes with a Hediff. All while keeping performance in mind, even with hundreds of animal traits in our dictionary. Core Features: This adds traits to animals and a few mechanics related to the traits such as genetics, but no new animals, and no new items. Traits that make animals unique are the main premise of this core framework. Configurable Trait Assignment System • Weight-based rarity: Common traits appear often, rare traits are special finds • Trait Inheritance Certain traits can be inherited by an animal's offpsring. • Savegame compatible Its designed to be savegame compatible, generates traits for all animals once you load the game, and you can even remove it without risk since its just mostly Hediff management. • Minimum/Maximum traits per animal: Control how many traits an animal can have • Chance for additional traits: Diminishing returns for more traits Custom Framework • New stats for animals: • Litter size (amount of children) • Egg laying amount (for chickens and stuff) • Revenge Chance Modifier on Tame failed • Revenge Chance Modifier on Damage taken I will make more stats like Explosion Size with time, I'd like ideas on what to make next... •Integration with Pawn columns You can view traits and stats directly in the animal list for ease of viewing • Animal-specific trait restrictions: Prevent nonsensical traits on certain species • Exclusivity rules Prevent conflicting traits from being assigned together because I didn't want strong and weak on the same animal, for example. • Mod settings for full customization Adjust all, and I mean all parameters ingame. You want the 'tough' animal trait to give 0.1% incoming damage multiplier? Go for it, it's in your hands. Seriously Commonality sliders Adjust just how common are traits. Make rare traits super rare, or make everything common. It starts at 24% commonality by default but you can pump it up to 100% or something like 5%. Animal Window Adds a custom window with detailed info about all traits on the selected animal, including stat modifiers and capacity modifiers. Can be renamed to 'Bio' tab and placed alongside the needs tab for better integration (check mod options). Debug Tools I've put a lot of effort into making debugging and testing easier for users and modders. There's a debug tab in mod settings that allows you to regenerate traits for all animals, view detailed logs, and some more stuff This core package comes with ~63 Traits Example General Traits: • Hungry: +25% hunger rate, +5% move speed, +15% metabolism • Sated: -30% hunger rate, +10% metabolism • Tough: -15% incoming damage, +15% injury healing, +10% pain threshold • Strong: +30% melee damage, +15% carrying capacity • Fast: +20% move speed, +15% dodge chance • Smart: +50% training speed, +15% consciousness • Docile: +35% trainability, -20% wildness, -30% revenge chance • Alpha: +40% melee damage, +15% consciousness, +10% manipulation Example Species-Specific Traits: • Muffalo Herd Leader: +20% damage, -15% incoming damage, +10% sight/hearing • Thrumbo Ancient One: +50% lifespan, -20% incoming damage, +20% consciousness • Wolf Pack Alpha: +35% damage, +10% move speed, +20% consciousness • Horse Warhorse: +40% damage, -20% incoming damage, +10% pain threshold • Chicken Champion Layer: +75% egg laying, +15% metabolism And 40+ more unique traits... More info: For Modders: Built as an extensible framework. Add your own traits by creating HediffDefs with the AnimalTraitExtension mod extension. There's a trait called "StatReference" that I've left unused in the core hediffs that you can use to see possible stats, I'll probably provide documentation at some point. • There's a 'dynamic discovery' function that automatically finds all traits with the AnimalTraitExtension and applies them to my dictionary, which means it's really easy for modders to add their own traits to their mod's animals without touching my code. Literally just add the hediff and the mod will work with the framework. • You can contact me through Discord or Steam if you need help... ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Personal Note from the Author If you're still here. I'd like to share a personal message about animals and their importance. Animals are not background elements of our world. They shape ecosystems, sustain balance, and reflect the health of the planet we all depend on. Protecting them does not require grand gestures. Supporting conservation efforts, reducing waste, consuming responsibly, and respecting wildlife habitats already make a measurable difference. Kindness toward animals matters more than most people realize. Please, always use your voice for good and to protect those who have none. Sincerely thank you for reading this and I hope you have the best time. Enjoy playing. RimWorld Version: 1.6.4633

name: Animals at Work — Herding Dogs
author: Royal-Tea
description: Every beast earns its keep. Second module of the Animals at Work series: herding dogs. - New "herding" training for dogs — and any clever animal of sufficient size (wolves, cougars, even elephants). - Herding: a trained dog spots pen animals straying outside their pen, runs to them and leads them home with the vanilla roping system — no colonist required, and strays get picked up along the way like a real flock. - Livestock defense: when a wild predator starts hunting one of your animals, dogs charge it, barking. And they defend as a pack — several dogs together scare off or fight predators none of them could face alone. Against the truly big ones, the barking at least raises the alarm. - Guard posts: assign one or more dogs to a pen, right on the pen marker. When idle they stand guard nearby, and the pack's combined size decides which prowling predators get scared off before they even strike. - Emergency roundup: during toxic fallout or an active hostile threat, dogs fetch strays even through dangerous ground. - Caravan help: while a caravan is forming, dogs bring the pen animals to the gathering spot on their own. - You'll see and hear the work: dogs bark on the charge and at their posts. Works with your existing vanilla animals: no special dog to buy, no micromanagement, no dependencies. Every Animals at Work module is standalone. French translation included (traduction française incluse). Also in the series: Plowing, Handy Monkeys, Pest Control. ───────── Version française ───────── Chaque bête gagne sa pitance. Deuxième module de la série Animals at Work : les chiens de berger. - Nouveau dressage « troupeau » pour les chiens — et tout animal futé d'assez bonne taille (loups, couguars, même les éléphants). - Le troupeau : un chien dressé repère les bêtes d'enclos qui s'égarent, court les chercher et les ramène au bercail avec le système de longe vanilla — aucun colon requis, et les égarées s'ajoutent en chemin, comme un vrai troupeau. - La défense du bétail : quand un prédateur sauvage chasse une de vos bêtes, les chiens le chargent en aboyant. Et ils défendent en meute — à plusieurs, ils font fuir ou affrontent des prédateurs qu'aucun n'oserait affronter seul. Face aux très gros, l'aboiement donne au moins l'alerte. - Le poste de garde : assignez un ou plusieurs chiens à un enclos, directement sur le marqueur d'enclos. Oisifs, ils montent la garde à proximité, et la taille cumulée de la meute décide quels prédateurs rôdeurs sont mis en fuite avant même de frapper. - Le rassemblement d'urgence : pendant des retombées toxiques ou une menace hostile, les chiens vont chercher les égarées même en zone dangereuse. - Le coup de patte aux caravanes : pendant la formation d'une caravane, les chiens amènent d'eux-mêmes les bêtes d'enclos au point de rassemblement. - Le travail se voit et s'entend : les chiens aboient à la charge comme au poste. Fonctionne avec vos animaux vanilla existants : pas de chien spécial à acheter, pas de micro-gestion, aucune dépendance. Chaque module Animals at Work est autonome. Autres modules : labour animal, singes artisans, lutte antiparasitaire.

name: Animals at Work — Plowing
author: Royal-Tea
description: Every beast earns its keep. First module of the Animals at Work series: animal plowing. - No training, no combat cows: draft work is a matter of gear. True draft species — horses, donkeys, cattle, muffalo, bison, yaks, dromedaries and elephants (animal mods can opt in with a two-line patch) — equip themselves and get to work, no intelligence required. An Unhitch button takes it all off. - The draft harness: stitched from leather, the foundation of all draft work, donned by the beast itself and carried as gear. Its wear shows right on the animal, and an alert fires when work is waiting with no harness left. - The plow: wood and share. A harnessed beast drags it across your growing zones (+30% fertility), never in frozen ground, and only where the zone allows it (one toggle per growing zone). The bigger the beast, the faster the furrow. The soil settles back after a season — the work never ends. - The draft cart: hitched by any harnessed beast, drawn behind it with the cargo in plain sight. It loads several stacks at once (up to 300 kg) and delivers the whole round in one trip, plus an extra 100 kg in caravans. One implement per beast: plow, cart or scraper. Gear drops when the beast dies. - The snow scraper: a broad wooden blade for the same beasts whose plows sit idle in frozen ground. A harnessed beast drags it across your snow-clearing area and scrapes the cells bare — no colonist shovels, no skill lost. Beasts swap implements with the seasons on their own: plow down when the earth freezes over or is fully turned, scraper down when the snow is gone. - The tack rack: a dedicated stand where colonists store harnesses, plows, carts and scrapers — three pieces per cell, safe from deterioration, ready for the beasts to help themselves. Requires Harmony. Every Animals at Work module is standalone. French translation included (traduction française incluse). Also in the series: Herding Dogs, Handy Monkeys, Pest Control. ───────── Version française ───────── Chaque bête gagne sa pitance. Premier module de la série Animals at Work : le labour animal. - Ni dressage, ni vaches de combat : le trait est affaire d'équipement. Les vraies espèces de trait — chevaux, ânes, bovins, muffalos, bisons, yaks, dromadaires et éléphants (les mods d'animaux peuvent s'inscrire avec un patch de deux lignes) — s'équipent d'elles-mêmes et se mettent au travail, sans intelligence requise. Un bouton « Détacher » retire tout. - Le harnais de trait : cousu dans le cuir, socle de tout travail de trait, enfilé par la bête elle-même et porté en équipement. Son usure se lit sur l'animal, et une alerte prévient quand du travail attend sans harnais disponible. - La charrue : du bois et un soc. Une bête harnachée la traîne sur vos zones de culture (+30 % de fertilité), jamais en sol gelé, et seulement où la zone l'autorise (un bouton par zone de culture). Plus la bête est grosse, plus le sillon avance. La terre se tasse après une saison — l'ouvrage ne finit jamais. - La charrette de trait : attelée par toute bête harnachée, tirée derrière elle avec le chargement bien en vue. Plusieurs piles d'un coup (jusqu'à 300 kg), toute la tournée en un seul voyage, et 100 kg de plus en caravane. Un seul attelage par bête : charrue, charrette ou grattoir. L'équipement tombe à la mort de la bête. - Le grattoir à neige : une large lame de bois pour les mêmes bêtes dont la charrue chôme dans la terre gelée. Une bête harnachée racle votre zone de déneigement — aucun colon à la pelle, aucune compétence perdue. Les bêtes changent d'attelage au fil des saisons, d'elles-mêmes : charrue posée quand la terre gèle ou est toute retournée, grattoir posé quand la neige est partie. - Le râtelier d'attelage : un support dédié où les colons rangent harnais, charrues, charrettes et grattoirs — trois pièces par case, à l'abri de la détérioration, à portée des bêtes. Nécessite Harmony. Chaque module Animals at Work est autonome. Autres modules : chiens de berger, singes artisans, lutte antiparasitaire.

name: Cats Hunt For Fun
author: Mlie
description: [img]https://i.imgur.com/iCj5o7O.png[/img] Cats will hunt for fun, not just when they are hungry. Adds a new activity for cats to hunt when not doing anything else. The hunting attack is always a surprise attack so the risk for the cat to get hurt is minimal. Cats will not try to hunt when hurt or downed. They will also not attack until the prey is downed or killed but can choose to just hit it once and walk away. (Cats are like that) If the gift-option is active, cats can take a valid prey in any health-state and leave it as a gift to their owner. There are options in the mod for - Range to search for prey in - How likely it is that a cat will attack a prey in range - How likely it is that a cat will bring a prey in range as a gift to their owner - Relative body-size to attack - Hunt only in home area - To not hunt animals belonging to the player colony - If wild animals should hunt for fun as well (they will ignore the above limitations regarding area and colony animals) What animals are considered "Cats" can be selected as well. There is built in support for some common cat-mods but if anyone is missing you can add it as well. Or go nuts and enable it for wild thrumbos and try to survive! author: plaxen
description: Add a cute and weak hamster to the harsh world of rimworld. It is very weak, but its fur is soft and pretty, making it a rare animal. Hamsters spouting out their fur.\n\n가혹한 림월드 세상에 귀엽고 약해빠진 햄스터를 추가합니다. 너무 약하지만 털이 부드럽고 예뻐서 희귀한 동물이 되었습니다. 햄스터는 털을 뿜어냅니다.

name: Map Designer
author: Zylle
description: More options for customizing maps! Use from mod settings under Options > Mod Settings > Map Designer. Mountains: - make flat or solid maps - hill size, shape, and positioning - hill shape - disable caves Terrain: - fertility - water - stone types per map Things - increase or decrease amount of: - plants - animals - ruins - steam geysers - ore - disable rock chunks - anima trees (if Royalty is active) - ideology map junk (if Ideology is active) - Biotech map stuff (pollution, polux trees, ancient mechs) - Medieval Overhaul map stuff Rivers: - size - style: vanilla, forked, confluence, oxbow, or spring - add river banks of sand, rich soil, or other terrain around rivers - pick river location and direction Beaches: - pick coast direction - custom beach terrain Map Features: optional special features you can add to your home map. - perfectly round islands: your map will generate as one or more perfectly round islands, surrounded by shallow water. Raids and trade caravans will still path in normally from the sides. - natural lakes: adds a configurable lake to your map. - natural islands: turns any map into an island, your choice of island shape and placement ----- Compatibility: Map Reroll - Compatible. You can change settings between rerolling! Map Preview - Compatible. You can access Map Designer settings from the preview, and the preview will update as you make changes! (Thanks to m00nl1ght for the integration) Compatible with most modded biomes. Biomes! Islands-- Islands should generate normally, terrain will not be changed. Plant and animal density adjustments will work. Coastlines-- compatible Real Ruins-- compatible Grand Rivers reborn-- overridden by this mod Ongoing games-- can be added or removed. Plant and animal density can change on existing maps. Extra anima trees can spawn on existing maps. Existing terrain will not change. ----- Not compatible with Configurable Maps. ----- Japanese translation by Proxyer Russian by TbMA and m0nka Spanish by Crusader ----- Github: https://github.com/Zylleon/MapDesigner/releases/latest Discord: https://discord.gg/4EFv76C ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/zylleon

name: More Birds - Conures
author: 11Bullets
description: Updated to Rimworld 1.6 This mod brings several species of conures to the game as pets and prey! Playful, colorful, attention-loving birds that will hop and flutter about your colony nuzzling your colonists and bringing joy with their goofy antics. Conures breed slowly and can be messy, but they will nuzzle often and are good pets. Thanks to the new Rimworld 1.6 flight mechanics each species has animated flight to move around and flee from threats! Conures are native to tropical rainforests, swamps, and grasslands. They have playful attitudes, attention seeking behavior, and enjoy antics like hanging and swinging upside down or swaying and dancing. The original inspiration for this mod was Junco's wonderful BIRD UP! series of mods. V1.3 For Rimworld 1.4 or 1.5, see the older mod https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2890898514

name: More Birds - Doves
author: 11Bullets
description: V1.0 This mod introduces flocks of wild and domesticated doves and pigeons as peaceful pets or a reliable, low-maintenance alternative fod source for your colony. Known for their gentle and low-maintenance nature, these birds are calming companions that vocalize a soft cooing song instead of loud whistles or screaming. They can be kept in aviaries or indoors and will generally thrive. Certain species are not fully domesticated, and will wander away unless penned. While they are prolific breeders and can be messy, their tranquil presence and usefulness make them a welcome addition to any settlement. Doves and pigeons are two names for the same group of birds from the Columbidae family. Terms are linguistic, rather than biological. 'Dove' is used in a poetic sense, 'pigeon' is used pragmatically. Thanks to the new Rimworld 1.6 flight mechanics each species has animated flight to move around and flee from threats! Doves and pigeons are a highly adaptable and diverse group of birds found in every biome except sea ice or ice sheet, occupying a wide range of climates and environments from deserts to tropical rainforests, while thriving in urban areas and settlements. They are affectionate animals that will bond and nuzzle colonists, improving moods and spirits. The original inspiration for this mod was Kestrel's wonderful BIRD UP! series of mods.

name: More Birds - Shorebirds
author: 11Bullets
description: V1.0 This entry in the More Birds series populates your beaches, marshes, and riverbanks with a diverse collection of water-loving avian fauna. From small, frantic shorebirds darting across the sand to towering, majestic waders hunting out in the shallows, these birds add visual depth and realism to your colony's waterways. Whether hunting them for their meat, harvesting their beautiful feathers for high-status tribal apparel, or domesticating them as prestigious companions for your throne halls and royal menageries, these birds revitalize your map’s coasts and wetlands. Introduces eight new species to the game: Cormorants, Egret, Ibises, Pelicans, Plovers, Sandpipers, Seagulls, and Spoonbills. Also (new for the More Birds series!) includes new furniture and apparel, as well as rebalancing Bird leather as a more luxurious material.

name: More Birds - Songbirds
author: 11Bullets
description: V1.1 This mod brings several species of songbirds to the game as pets and prey! Playful, colorful, singing birds that will hop and flutter about the wilderness, serenading colonists and bringing joy with their beautiful songs. They breed slowly and can be messy, but their lilting songs will bring joy to your colony. Songbirds sing their songs, providing a slight mood increase to those who are nearby. It's not game-breaking, but it's enough to counter the fact that your colonist just had a picnic in the woods and didn't bring a table and chairs! Thanks to the new Rimworld 1.6 flight mechanics each species has animated flight to move around and flee from threats! Songbirds are found in many biomes due to their wide-ranging migration patterns that take advantage of seasonal food availability, nesting needs, and climates to fledge young. They have skittish attitudes, do not nuzzle, and tend to make poor pets, but their beautiful songs will brighten the moods of colonists who hear them! The original inspiration for this mod was Junco's wonderful BIRD UP! series of mods. Credits: Taranchuk, Shun The Witch, and Jerry The Cultist for the C# code for the bird song mood buff.

name: More Milkable and Shearable Animals
author: Kobe Riddle
description:
A series of patches to ensure that all animals that could feasibly be milked or sheared can be, increasing the options for milk and wool!

Animals which would be harder to milk (those without a nice udder) give less milk than their similarly-sized counterparts, for both "realism" and balance.

Patches for animal mods included!

name: Mythic Ages: Megafauna Bestiary
author: Veterano
description: Enter the Mythic Ages, where ancient megafauna roam wild lands shaped by a forgotten project now remembered only as legend. Hunt them, tame them, or raise them at your own risk. Their meat, milk, wool, hides, bones, horns, organs, spores, and stranger byproducts can become food, clothing, medicine, drugs, weapons, or wealth. Built for runs from tribal to industrial colonies, Mythic Ages keeps wildlife dangerous, useful, and tied to a past still breathing in the wild.

name: Pack Mules Extended
author: Leigh
description: Ever wondered why your not so bright, cannon fodder Alpaca's are able to carry your caravan's supplies but your super intelligent Thumbro can't? It doesn't make sense! That's why this mod extends pack animal capabilities to apply to other larger animals. Currently the mod extends the following animals. - Bears (Grizzly & Polar) - Cow - Megasloth - Pig - Thrumbo - Rhinoceros Compatibility This mod should be 100% compatible with any mod, even those that modify the above animals. This is due to using patch operations and sequencing. Even mods that packify and animal in theory would be compatible with the exception that you may get texture conflicts. NOTE: This mod was 100% inspired by Dragoon_103's Packified Animals mod. While no resources were directly taken from his / her mod, this mod wouldn't exist without his / her idea and general approach. If he / she requests that I take this mod down, I will respectfully do so!

name: Rimmessian Fox
author: Aqued, LiLMaDDonuT, Hubertdragon
description: This mod adds Rimmessian foxes, a Rimworld twist on the mythological creature of the Teumessian fox.

name: VFME - Caravan Packs!
author: PlayIgel, Alastair, Kayedon, SalmonToastie, Xrushha
description: Caravan Packs! is your simple solution to expanding your choice on what animals can be used in caravans! We added packs to every animal that made sense to us, from Core to over a dozen mods. Enjoy pack support for 23 animals from the base game and 50+ more from the mods below! Adds packs to Erin's Palamutes, Anima Animals, ReGrowth - Wasteland Animals, ReGrowth - Extinct Animals, Android Tiers, Vanilla Factions Expanded - Insectoids and Vikings, and Vanilla Animals Expanded Arid Shrubland, Australia, Boreal Forest, Cats and Dogs, Caves, Desert, Ice Sheet, Tropical Rainforest, and Tundra. Additionally, several animals from core and the above mods have new pack textures to better match our mod. Works best loaded after any mod that we support animals for. Will automatically ask to be there!

name: Biomes! Polluted Lands
author: The Biomes Mod Team
description: Adds an assortment of new plants and animals to polluted vanilla biomes as well as some modded ones. Have you ever tried out living in a polluted biome, whether it be settling in one or polluting your home tile and found it really really boring? Well this mod is for you, because it makes polluted biomes feel much more alive and interesting. From mutated predator birds to green-tinged sheep, you'll have lots of new things to play with.

name: Cybranian - Vacworld
author: DimonSever000
description: The mod adds a new biome - vacstone wasteland, as well as a custom planet.

name: Geological Landforms
author: m00nl1ght
description: Adds 44 landforms to the game, which generate biome-independently. The goal of this mod is to make map generation more interesting and varied, compared to the vanilla experience of simply having either a cliff or a coast on one edge of your map.

name: Giant crop
author: LingLuo;金兔子拉面;冰皮汤圆
description: 添加了一系列的巨型作物,当你以矩形种植作物时,在成熟时有概率生成巨型作物,它们能提供巨量的美观,并且能够在拆除后产出大量对应的产物. 可巨大化的原版作物:土豆,水稻,玉米,营养菇(DLC),恶魔菇,棉花,药草,龙舌兰,草莓,啤酒花,仙馐果,可可树,仙人掌,蒲公英,黄花,玫瑰,七色花(DLC),毒薯(DLC) 新增的可巨大化作物:卷心菜,菠萝,彩椒,番茄,胡萝卜,花菜,茄子,南瓜,莴笋,西瓜,香蕉,洋葱,竹笋,苹果,芒果,白萝卜,榴莲,火龙果,核桃 A series of giant crop varieties were added which have the potential to generate at a rectangular planting mode. When they mature, there's a chance for them to evolve into giant crops that provide immense aesthetic value and can yield copious amounts of corresponding products upon demolition. Original version crops that are capable of becoming giants: potatoes, rice, corn, nutritional mushroom (DLC), devilstrand, cotton, healroot, agave, strawberry, hops, ambrosia, cocoa tree, saguaro cactus, dandelion, daylily, rose, tinctoria (DLC), toxipotato (DLC) Newly added crops that can become gigantic: cabbage, pineapple, bell pepper, tomato, carrot, cauliflower, eggplant, pumpkin, lettuce, watermelon, banana, onion, bamboo shoots, apple, mango, daikon, durian, pitaya, walnut

name: ReGrowth 2
author: Helixien
description: ReGrowth: Core is both a content mod and a small framework, aiming to overhaul and improve on Rimworlds vanilla biomes, add new and unique features and biomes, replace many of the vanilla plant textures with HD ones and, in combination with its companion mods, add new plants that fit perfectly into the vanilla artstyle. On top of that, it adds a lot of new weather types, many with custom visual effects to spice up your game. ReGrowth is, at its core, a mod deeply influenced by the philosophy of the Vanilla Expanded Series. Everything it adds fits into Vanilla Rimworld. Every system (like for example new terrain) is designed to mimic how similar vanilla systems work while also being as friendly to your games performance as possible. NOTHING in this mod will absolutely tank your FPS and the few features that do cost some performance are optional. This mod is the Core, which is a requirement for all other ReGrowth mods. Please note the new terrain will only be seen in new biomes that use them, not in vanilla biomes. This mod is as lightweight as possible, adding the minimum of code required and every bit of code written has performance in mind!

name: ReGrowth 2: Aspen
author: Helixien
description: ReGrowth is a mod deeply influenced by the philosophy of the Vanilla Expanded Series and the understanding how biomes work, what role they play in your game. Everything added was made to fit or mirror vanilla. From a simple UI texture to a new more complex system,being as performance and vanilla friendly is the main objective we have. Inspired by my favorite game, "Skyrim", Aspen Forests is a new biome filled with genetically engineered Aspen trees, new flowers and grass. It is beautiful, colourful and unique. Aspen Forests are a simple biome, there is no performance hungry code or new features you will only find there. Its goal is to add variety for the player. ReGrowth is designed to be as lightweight as possible, adding the minimum of new code required for its auditions to work.

name: ReGrowth: Boiling
author: Helixien
description: ReGrowth is a mod deeply influenced by the philosophy of the Vanilla Expanded Series and the understanding how biomes work, what role they play in your game. Everything added was made to fit or mirror vanilla. From a simple UI texture to a new more complex system,being as performance and vanilla friendly is the main objective we have. Inspired by the Disney show “The Owl House”, the Boiling Forests is a new biome filled with colourful trees, plants and hotsprings. Created by a long gone megacorp for an immersive theme park, it is unknown how this biome made its way to a Rimworld. It is by far the most unique biome I have made so far and I am honestly stunned by it myself. Boiling Forests are a simple biome, there is no performance hungry code you can't turn off or new features you will only find there. Its goal is to add variety for the player and to bring things from “The Owl House” into Rimworld in a lore friendly way! ReGrowth is designed to be as lightweight as possible, adding the minimum of new code required for its auditions to work.

name: Winter Taiga Biome 2
author: Reel
description: Adds a unique vanilla-friendly Permanent Winter Forest biome with unique Trees, Bushes, and other flora that changes appearance between Summer to Winter. Also comes with a new special Mushroom that gives temperature resistance when consumed raw. Welcome to the sequel to my first ever biome mod! This adds a unique vanilla-friendly Permanent Winter Forest biome with unique Trees, Bushes, and other flora that changes appearance between Summer to Winter! These trees and flora are only exclusive to this biome, and will not conflict with any other biomes, modded or otherwise. This mod also comes with new harvestable plants that can grow in the winter, and brand new flora textures that follow the same style and quality of mods like ReGrowth 2! Before I first made Winter Taiga Biome, I was always bothered by Boreal Forests never delivering on the "harsh winters" comment, which was mostly to do with the flora and trees not being covered by snow during winter. So I decided to make my own biome mod to fulfil my own desire of a Winter Forest. After Odyssey came out, I decided to go the extra mile and remake the entire mod altogether, with updated textures, bugfixes and new additions. The Winter Wonderland of your dreams begins here! Safe to add, unsafe to remove. You'll need to make a new playthrough to see the biome.

name: Actually Vanilla Music Expansion
author: Billnotic
description: I'm sure you're tired of looking for mods that add new tracks, only for them to hardly fit among the vanilla ones. Even if they are great songs of their own right, you just can't play with that dissonance. I feel the same way, this is my attempt at rectifying that. I love Alistair's style, he did a wonderful job with the OST and it's a shame so many music mods diverge from his iconic sound so much. NOTE: For some reason the Music Manager bugs out when you skim to different points of a track added by this mod. Dunno why that's the case but keep that in mind if you're using it (it isn't required).

name: Music Blocker (屏蔽音乐)
author: trigger
description: [h1]Music Blocker - Music Manager Extension[/h1] This is a specialized extension for [b]Music Manager (Continued)[/b]. It fills the gap by allowing you to disable specific tracks, giving you full control over your colony's playlist. [h2]Features[/h2] [list] [*] [b]Integrated Block Toggles[/b]: Adds a checkbox column directly to the Music Manager's song list. Check to play, uncheck to block. [*] [b]Drag-Select Support[/b]: Quickly toggle multiple songs by clicking and dragging your mouse, just like in a spreadsheet. [*] [b]Persistent Settings[/b]: Your blocking preferences are saved permanently and will persist even after restarting the game. [*] [b]Seamless Integration[/b]: Blends perfectly into the original UI without adding cluttered setting menus. [/list] [h2]Installation[/h2] This mod requires [b]Music Manager (Continued)[/b]. Make sure to load this mod [b]AFTER[/b] the original mod. [hr] [h1]P-music 屏蔽音乐扩展[/h1] 这是一个为 [b]Music Manager (Continued)[/b] 模组量身定制的扩展补丁。它填补了原模组无法禁用特定音乐的遗憾，让你可以完全掌控自己的播放列表。 [h2]核心功能[/h2] [list] [*] [b]直观的屏蔽开关[/b]：在 Music Manager 的播放列表右侧直接添加了一列复选框，勾选即播放，取消即屏蔽。 [*] [b]支持拖拽选择[/b]：你可以像在 Excel 中一样，点击并拖拽鼠标快速勾选或取消多首歌曲，整理超长列表不再痛苦。 [*] [b]持久化保存[/b]：你的屏蔽设置会自动保存，即使重启游戏也会依然生效。 [*] [b]无缝集成[/b]：完美融入原模组 UI，不产生额外的设置菜单，保持界面整洁。 [/list] [h2]安装说明[/h2] 本模组依赖于 [b]Music Manager (Continued)[/b]，请确保已安装并将其加载在原模组之后。

name: Music Manager (Continued)
author: Zaljerem
description: Original mod by Fluffy https://ludeon.com/forums/index.php?topic=16120 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2229205672 MIT and Share-Alike licenses Even so, if the original author requests it, or I see the original mod updates, I will remove this update. -- I couldn't live without some music controls, immediately, in 1.5 ... All props to Fluffy for this and their other mods. You're a legend. Caveats: 1. The "Previous" button now just returns you to the start of the currently playing song. You can always pick a song directly from the menu. The "Next" button plays a random appropriate song. "Play/Pause" works as normal - will pause/resume if playing, will start a random track if no song playing. [Bug fixed!] 2. Any previous bugs/issues/functionality problems are untouched, and new ones may have arisen! 3. I may or may not do anything about improving this mod further, it seems to work for what I need it to do, and maybe you too. I make no promises. Anyway, source is included - improve it. I'd be only too happy to remove this mod if a better one arrives or if the original updates. -- Original mod notes (1.4): Manage your music. Like a boss. Features: Adds a music player widget to the game, with the usual audio control buttons; pause, play, next song, etc. The widget defaults to the top right of the screen, but can be unlocked in the mod settings, and then moved around at will. Also included is a larger interface that lists all the songs available, and allows you to disable specific songs[not working?], change under which conditions songs are allowed to be played, and start playing any song in the database. Custom metadata is persisted across games. You can reset all metadata in the mods' settings screen. You can control the default interval between songs by moving the appropriate sliders in the mods' settings screen. Compatibility with other mods: Music Manager is fully compatible with other mods that add music to the game.

description: Adds a new grave called the Crypto Coffin. It preserves bodies and stops them from rotting. With RimCryptoEconomy installed, the Crypto Coffin can double as a crypto mining server. The catch? You'll need a corpse with a brain. No skeletons, no empty coffins of bones. Damaged brains are still fine, as long as one's in there. Once that's set, their brainpower gets redirected into mining coins from beyond the grave. Use every raider's body to build your undead crypto empire... just don't tell anyone you got the idea from me! Check Steam mod page for more details.

The mod also implements power crossing for cross-wiring without mixing. The mod includes translations into the following languages: Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, and Ukrainian. A more detailed description of the mod and its additions can be found in the Steam Workshop description. This is my first mod, and I always welcome feedback. If you encounter any errors, please feel free to contact me.

name: P–5000 Powered Work Loader

Power Loaders were equipped with hydraulic "claws" that can be used to hold and manipulate a variety of objects. __Xenopedia Wiki

name: Reverse Engineered Region Adjusters
author: Pal 5k, GoGaTio
description: Reverse Engineered Region Adjusters grants the player access to many of the world affecting buildings that are normally used against them. Constructing these buildings requires the player to go through an involved research tree, and to best one of the structures they wish to reconstruct. While at first glance many of these buildings may seem useless, there is some great potential with combinations such as wasters with a toxic spewer, or the sun blocker with a darkness ideology. Compared to the standard versions these player controlled adjusters are much more configurable, and the functions of the buildings are same aside from their smaller world map ranges. The reverse engineer-able buildings are: Climate Adjuster Weather Controller EMI Dynamo Toxic Spewer Smoke Spewer Defoliator SunBlocker

name: VFE-Deserters: Remote Deadlife IED
author: Kimoju
description: [h1] What does this mod do? [/h1] Simply add a functionnal remote variant of the deadlife dust IED. Works exactly the same as any remote IED, but with deadlife. I did my best to to give the IED the same grayisht tint that regular deadlife ied use, while sticking to the remote IED template. DISCLAIMER: I do not claim this idea as my own, nor is it an attempt to replace VE official content. The goal of this mod is purely to fill the gap of the missing IED while waiting for an official version to replace it. [h1] F.A.Q [/h1] Q: Isn't this already in VFE-Deserters? A: No, sadly the romotes IED were not updated when Anomaly released, making it the only IED without a remote variant. Q: CE compatible? A: ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ Q: Is it compatible with [i] insert x mod [/i] in particular ? A: Yes Q: Can I add it mid playthrough? A: You should, I wouldn't try remove it mid playthrough though. The def name use the VE naming convention, meaning that if/when Deserters gets updated, it should be safe to remove this mod before loading the updated version. [h1] Credits [/h1] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Oskarpotocki/myworkshopfiles/] Oskar Potocki and the Vanilla Expended team[/url] for the awesome mods. description: Adds three prisoner jumpsuit clothing items. name: Animal Cages (Continued)
author: Zaljerem
description: Original mod by ZzZombo https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2458577231 If the original author requests it, I will remove this update. -- Original mod notes (1.2): # Description This mod adds cages to hold wild (or your own) animals captive inside them. The animals can't escape it, are generally peaceful, and will be looked after by your handlers. To capture an animal it has to be incapacitated first. Then any handler can bring one into a cage it's assigned to; you can select a cage and assign any animal valid for the cage. By default cages allow any animal outside your faction, but if need be, you can toggle it to instead accept your own animals. # Features * Currently has cages of a 2×3, 3×3 and 5x5 sizes capable of holding a single animal/three/two animals respectively of most sizes (up to and including the size of a human). Should fit most vanilla animals. * Handlers automatically capture downed marked animals. Colonists take care of animals inside. * Captive animals roam inside the cage w/o getting out, although there are no physical barriers involved in construction of the cages as far as RimWorld is concerned; it's a single building. * Access inside/outside cages is possible only via the entrance cell. But the cage doesn't prevent interaction through the bars up to one cell in either direction. In particular, hungry creatures can snatch food lying close enough outside. * If captive animals somehow become free, they will attempt to flee the map. # Known issues [unverified in 1.5] * Improper rendering of the cages with objects always drawn on top of them. * If you unassign a creature from a cage w/o assigning it to another cage, it will be instantly considered free. Instead, if you wish to move it from one cage into another, just assign it to the destination cage directly. A colonist will transfer the creature as told. This might also happen by accident if you assign a cage more creatures than it can hold, the earliest assigned creature will be automatically unassigned, thus becoming free. * Currently cages can become overpopulated (become stuffed w/ more animals than they may hold) under certain conditions. A better assignment and release system is underway.

Build Large Piped Air Climate Systems away from your buildings. ----- [strike] NOTICE: This mod is no longer maintained. Due to recent life changes, It is hard to find time for this mod. The license has been modified to MIT License so people have been given freedom to modify the mod itself. Overall, the mod still works fine, there may be incompatibilities with other mods that I would not have discovered. I highly recommend looking at the Getting Started guide on steam if you are trying it out. [/strike] ----- Rimworld Version: 1.0.0 (Check Github releases for older versions) Version: 1.5.0 [url=https://ludeon.com/forums/index.php?topic=34346.0]Forum Link[/url] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1078768280]Recommended: Steam Guide for Creating a Basic Setup[/url] Watch this video if you are having issues with the guides. It’s a little old, but covers the basic usage of the mod! [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1tnF4kdAnxk]Youtube Video Link (BaRKy)[/url] While there are many alternate mods for Central Heating. This mod adds a new network-like resource (like electricity) Air. The heating/cooling system you will build depends on the number of rooms and the heating/cooling capacity of your air networks. There are 3 colored pipes available. All can carry any type of air. Following buildings are added: - Air Intake Fan: Fans to supply air to the system - Air Climate Control System: Heat or Cool air to a target temperature - Air Vents: Vent out the heated/cooled air - Wall Mounted Air Vents - Large Intakes and Air Climate Units [h1] Features and Differences (from other mods): [/h1] [b] Unified Heating/Cooling System [/b] Heating and Cooling is done by 1 unit, so reduces the need to build coolers and heaters. [b] Outside (and Far away) Heat Exhaust: [/b] The Heat Exhaust of the Climate Control units isn’t located adjacent to rooms. They are located far away from your rooms, thus allowing you to make adjacent rooms to fridge rooms. [b] Air Network [/b] There is a network-like resource (like electricity) which is generated and consumed which is further dictated by Efficiency of the Network. 1) Flow Efficiency The rate at which your rooms will cool/heat or maintain heat due to changes in the room temps. Value: 1 Intake Fan for 3 Rooms 2) Thermal Efficiency The rate at which your Climate Control units can heat the air. Sudden changes like Cold Snaps or Heat wave will inject very cold or very hot air into your system. Climate Control Units will take care that, but their rate is determined by this Efficiency unit. Value: 1 Climate Control Unit for 3 Intake Fan You can always check efficiency of each network at the Vents. [b] Air Temperature inside Pipes [/b] This mod also deals with the temperature of the air in the Pipe Network. [b] Can share air without Climate Control units [/b] Intakes take note of the Air Temperature the take in. We can practically make Climate Control-less networks that share the same temperature. For example: Multiple Frigdes can be connected together, but only 1 is getting the cooling. The rest just share the air. [b] Bigger buildings for late game [/b] Build larger Intakes and Climate Units which have about 5x more power than a regular machine. [b] Pipe Switches [/b] If you have multiple pipes near your vent, You can force it to connect to a specific pipe. [h1] Installation: [/h1] 1) Make sure you enable HugsLib first and before this Mod 2) Enable the Mod in the Mod List [h1] Known Issues: [/h1] - Compatibility Issues with Redist.Heat Mod - Reinstall doesn’t work properly (Install and Uninstall works fine.) [h1] Note: [/h1] This is my first mod for any game ever. There might be some issues. I wanted to see how the community responds to my mod, and want to work more on it! :) Thanks if you are trying my mod out! name: Expanded Prosthetics and Organ Engineering - Forked
author: Victorique, Aurani, Tarojun
description: Adds the ability to craft tons of prosthesis and artificial organs in various forms and shapes. Version 4.4.7. New option settings available if XML Extension mod is active, available on Steam workshop at: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2574315206 It comes built in options for Remove workbenches, Allow direct crafting, Direct crafting only and Legacy mode, so you no longer require the add-on modules if you have this active and simply use the mods settings to apply them. Features: * Two prosthetic workbench: Bionic workbench and Synthetic nano printer. * The workbenches can link up with each other and the Fabrication workbench to improve production speed. * Patches for Cyber Fauna and Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Production to allow additional link ups. * Two new orbital ship traders: Prosthesis and Textile trader. * Ability to additionally harvest Stomach, Eye, Nose, Ear and Jaw body parts. Plays well with QEE. * Can mince natural body parts for human meat. * Can heal scars and numerious chronic health conditions. Additional patch to work with Scar Removal Plus mod. * Some prosthesis can be further upgraded. * Body purist friendly augmentations in the form of Organic Optimizers and Instinct Optimizers. * Ability to scrap unwanted prosthesis for materials. * Different add-on modules to further customize the mod: - Royalty DLC expansion, adds new implants and bionics based off the new Royalty DLC content. - Alien expansion + patcher, helps expand upon bionic content and certain issues with certain alien race mods. * The following add-on modules are built-in with using the XML Extension mod, but if you do not use that, then they are: - Remove workbenches, adds crafting to vanilla workbenches, but disable building new EPOE workbenches. - Allow direct crafting, enables higher tier recipes to be made in one go at the same total costs. - Direct crafting only, enables higher tier recipes to be made in one go at the same total costs, and removes upgrading methods. - Legacy mode, reverts crafting costs and methods to version 3.3.13 of the mod. Has unique compatibility with [FSF] Advanced Bionics Expansion on game version 1.5. When running both mods at the same time, you agree to: * EPOE-Forked and ABE are not liable to any errors generated with other mod interactions due to running both mods. * EPOE-Forked and ABE are not liable to texture inconsistencies due to running both mods. * EPOE-Forked and ABE will not attempt re-balancing stats to each other when both mods are active. Requests for this situation will be ignored by both parties. * EPOE-Forked and ABE will continue their respective independent development of their mods, and not liable to testing, checking or notifying each other if a new interaction conflict may appear. Compared with original EPOE, this mod will see continued development and rebalancing, active bug fixes, and strives to follow vanilla's standard.

name: LWM's Deep Storage
author: Little White Mouse
description: Deep Storage Units: yet another storage solution LWM presents a way to organize your supplies, loot, clothes, and even your garbage, to allow you a tidy base where your colonists aren't simply dumping stuff on the floor. Deep Storage units include medicine cabinets, meat hooks, clothing racks, weapon lockers, etc, and all can store diverse items - just like regular shelves, but they allow more than one thing! ADDON MODS: * Note: I have not used these, and have been super busy so haven't had a chance to add anything to the base mod. If you find right-clicking on storage slow, you might try this: * A (faster?) UI for right-clicking on things: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2169841018 * Little Storage 2, Vault, Simple Storage, etc - if you want more ways to store things, there are several available in the Steam workshop! FAQ / "I have a problem": * Meat Hooks require the Smithing research! * These Hampers are made of fabric, they don't hold fabric * Does it work with Vanilla shelves? * You can always add more stored things in Mod Settings ** (A little walkthrough for doing that: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2187075071) Want to say Thanks? * Have ** in Art? Draw me a picture of a little white mouse! I'm reachable on the Ludeon forum. * Have extra spending money? Share a cup of something tasty (some places around here deliver!) at https://ko-fi.com/littlewhitemouse Notes: * Storing things properly takes time - the colonists must carefully organize everything so it's easy to find what's needed.(*) * Animals cannot by default haul to Storage - their little brains and paws (claws, etc) cannot manage the clasps, locks, catches, etc required to store things properly.(*) * All the units you can build are in the Storage menu - by default this includes other mods' storage buildings.(*) * (*) - these can be changed in the Mod Settings (again, link above) Compatibility: * Storage compatible with many different mods: Dubs Bad Hygiene, RimCuisine, Survival Tools, Vegetable Garden. If you see something that SHOULD be stored but isn't? You can let me know! * You can also change what's allowed in the Mod Settings! * Plays well with mods that change stack size (OgreStack, Deep Stack, etc). Want 10 stacks of 1000 Advanced Components in one square? Go for it! (Just watch out for mortar attacks...) * Plays well with mods that affect storage: Restricted Storage (LWM), Satisfied Storage, RimWorld Search Agency (not as well as Satisfied Storage), Stockpile for Disaster, heck - there's a Deep Refrigerator if you play with RimFridge * Plays well with mods that affect hauling: CommonSense, Pick Up and Haul. * Haul To Stack? I have conflicting reports, let me know. * Other storage mods? maybe: ** Project RimFactory: probably okay, should be fully compatible soon ** Extended Storage: maybe ** Other storage mod??? If you get weird behavior, turn off "Over Capacity" check in mod settings * Industrial Rollers: not fully, but fix is coming! Want more types of units? Frozen organ storage? Piggy banks for silver? Cubbyholes for bedrolls? You can either make your own derived mod (the XML is a mess, but it's a documented mess, and it's easy enough to follow!) or you can suggest things to me and offer to acquire a graphic (draw it yourself, find a free one, make deals with demons, whatever). Translations: Русский - Тхакиро Deutsch - Erdnussbrot Chinese Traditional - shiuanyue Note on Translations: These may not be complete translations, as I do add things from time to time. Want to translate it (all or part) into your language? Great! Let me know, I'll add it to the mod (or do a Pull Request on GitHub, if you do that thing - that is easiest for me!) The code can be found online at: https://github.com/lilwhitemouse/RimWorld-LWM.DeepStorage On Steam: https://steamcommunity.com/id/littlewhitemouse/myworkshopfiles/?appid=294100 In the Ludeon Forum: https://ludeon.com/forums/index.php?topic=47707.0 License Most images used with permission from Skullywag. Almost all code (c) LWM, released under LGPL, because I think that the LGPL is the license we should actually be using for mods. Not that anyone is likely to complain if we use something else, but altho we have a stupid copyright system, we should still use it correctly. Thanks to Marnador for the RimWorld font. Thanks to Pardeike for Harmony. Awesome.

name: Mahjong Table
author: YAYOFLAKE
description: This mod adds various Mahjong tables to the game. Each Mahjong table can accommodate up to 4 players and must have chairs next to it for the colonists to use.

name: Medical Dissection
author: Heremeus
description: Medical Dissection adds a dissection table to the game, allowing your doctors to train on human corpses. You can add the mod to an existing save. Feature overview - Performing dissections allows your doctors to train their medicine skill on humanoid corpses - Colonists assigned to the new "Study Medicine" work type will perform dissection bills at a dissection table to train their skill - Dissecting a single body takes 1.5 ingame hours and grants 3000xp (adjustable in settings) - Dissection removes random body parts and organs from the corpse - Colonists may accidentally destroy corpses in the dissection process (lower chance with higher medicine skill) - A corpse can only be dissected once (A "Allow dissected" and "Allow not dissected" filter can help you to set up your storages and butcher bills efficiently) - Custom thoughts and tales v2.13

name: Medieval Signs
author: Mewn Goddess
description: This mod adds 14 decorative medieval styled signboards that can be used to mark different types of buildings so your colony looks more organized and lived-in. The added signs are: inn, flophouse, tavern, stables, armory, archery, library, magic shop, butcher, tailor, quarry, blacksmith, apothecary and shop. This is a reworked version of my earlier mini mod - Medieval Overhaul Extra Signs, which obviously required the Medieval Overhaul mod to function. But this version comes with entirely new textures and is completely standalone, though the two mods are still fully compatible if used together. To include different designs and at the same time keep the Furniture tab relatively clean, I've combined 3 texture variations of a single sign into one building. You just need to rotate a sign while placing it to switch between different textures.

name: Miniature Props and Decor
author: Leo39994
description: Tired of empty tables and bare shelves? Over 140 purely decorative props and decorations to bring life and personality to your colony's homes! From collectible figures, plush toys, and tiny mementos to decorative dishes and everyday clutter, give your colonists the cozy, detailed home they deserve. (Some items or furniture come with an interesting description.) Features: - No Cost, Instant Build: Requires no materials and zero work to build. Decorating is easy and instant, even on the highest difficulties! - No Path Cost: Does not block sight or movement. - Purely Decorative: Don't let functionality limit your building creativity—these items have zero functional impact. Art design for some items is inspired by the game series "Girls' Frontline."

name: More Gravship Workbenches
author: LTS
description:
An unofficial addon for 'VGE - Chapter 1' that adds new compact gravship variants for various workbenches.

Includes: 
Compact Bioferrite Shaper (Requires Anomaly) 
Compact Serum Lab (Requires Anomaly, also doubles as a draught lab if VFE Medieval 2 is active) 
Compact Laser Cutter (Requires Jewelry, functions as an art and stonecutting table) 
Compact Recycling Bench (Requires Vanilla Recycling Expanded) 
Compact Bionic Module Bench (Requires Integrated Implants) 
Compact Android Parts Workbench (Requires Vanilla Races Expanded - Androids) 
Compact Garage Bench (Requires Vanilla Vehicles Expanded) 
Compact Nutrient Paste Grinder (Requires Vanilla Nutrient Paste Expanded, functions as it's own hoppers)

name: More Religious Origins
author: Kirby
description: This mod adds more religious structures, and some styles associated with them. Styles include sculptures and ideograms, and miscellaneous furniture and architectural elements like columns, lamps, and chairs Currently Daoism, Shinto, Norse, Hellenic, Egyptian, Aztec, and Druidic are implemented. Daoist and Shinto can build incense shrines Norse and Hellenic can perform animal sacrifices Aztec can perform prisoner sacrifices Druidic can perform effigy burnings Future plans include adding more styles, and expanding styles to include things like furniture, floor slabs, and so on

name: More Ritual Seats
author: Toastyman
description: This mod aims to give ideoligions more variety and flavor by adding more ritual seats. - Ritual standing spots: simple spots for spectators to stand on - Prie-dieux: single-tile benches for pawns to kneel on - Box pews: four-by-four pews that are enclosed by low-lying walls - Cushioned pews: pews with upholstery for added comfort - Drum stools and benches: drums that are strong enough to be sat upon by ritual spectators - Meditation stones: large smooth stones for meditative ideoligions - Slab pews: uncomfortable benches that barely pass for pews - Worship pits: dug open pits on the ground for ideoligions that either love dirt (or really hate themselves) It also adds building style textures for some of the ritual seats. Some modded styles are also supported. - Morbid, Techist - Serketist, Hedonist (Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures) - Gothic, Bloody Gothic (ATH's style Gothic and Bloody Gothic) - Neolithic, Ocular, Jewish (Alpha Memes) - Dwarven (Stoneborn - Dwarven Style Pack)

name: Museums
author: NightmareCorporation
description: Have you ever wanted to show off some of the cool stuff your colonists have found or made? Love the reliquaries and relics from Ideology but can't be compelled to invest months of in-game time to retrieve a single relic? Museums is the mod for you. Features - Fence-like buildings to restrict access to museum visitors - Signs with different icons - Display-buildings and pedestals that can display resources - Room role: Museum - Requires at least one watchable building and a museum gathering spot - Joy logic for solo-touring a museum - Gatherings for colonists to go on a guided tour - Work like parties, triggered randomly with a random organizer - Watchable Buildings - Supported buildings have new gizmos, with which you can define positions from which pawns may look at that building whilst on a museum tour

name: Opulent Gold
author: Visander Sovereign
description: This mod adds two types of flooring to fill your vaults and properly display the honestly unhealthy amounts of wealth you have been hoarding. Psychologists discourage the distribution of these to dragons, or affiliated xenotypes. In addition to adding these oh so exuberantly expensive floors this mod also addresses the horrible disservice done to the vanilla gold colour and adjusts it to match the alluring warmth and lustre we all desire. Last but not least, metal floor-tiles have been adjusted to practically shine with the glamour of the newly introduced golden splendour.

name: Oxygen Detector
author: Chirpful
description: Adds a new building called the Oxygen Detector. The display will remain green if there's oxygen present within a room, and will raise an alarm when there's not.

name: Panels, Frames & Stairs
author: kongkim
description: Let you build door frames and panels that gives beauty, around the floors or to divide areas.

name: Phaneron's Basic Storage
description: Basic Storage is an attempt at making a lightweight storage mod based on the Adaptive Storage Framework, that offers highly variable storage buildings without cluttering your storage tab with too many options.

name: Polyamory Beds (Vanilla Edition)
author: lagking, Meltup, Sicarious
description: More beds for your polyamorous pawns! This mod is a spiritual successor of Polygamy Beds by Joseph with code being completely rewritten by Meltup. I have updated it to 1.5 and fixed a typo. Please message me if you want this mod taken down or there is an error. Features: - Triple, quadra sleeping spots and bedrolls (avaliable from the start); - Triple, quadra beds and royal beds (require 'Complex Furniture' to be researched, royal beds also require 8 skill in Construction); - Penta royal bed (requires 'Complex Furniture' to be researched, 8 skill in Construction). Stats are carefully balanced to be in line with Vanilla beds, graphics is updated. Known issues - Some other mods may interfere with game's miniaturisation mechanics thus making it possible to install/uninstall sleeping spots (and you may get also get messages about 'Outdoor penalty' when placing sleeping spots outside). Solution: move this mod above those mods. - Modded Royal Titles may not recognise larger beds as suitable substitutes for double beds of that type. Solution: move this mod below the mod adding the titles. - Pawns with a Spouse-Only Physical Love precept cannot sleep with multiple spouses at the same time unless their spouses are also married to each other. Solution: this is Vanilla behaviour outside the scope of this mod. [SIC] Co-Spousal Relations is one mod that addresses this. Please report any problems and/or inconsequences!

name: Ponpeco Furnitures : Sci-Fi
author: ponpeco
description: This is a furniture mod designed with a sci-fi aesthetic. The pieces are inspired by starships, cyberspace, and futuristic research facilities. I hope you’ll enjoy using them to create everything from sleek gravship interiors to the atmosphere of a Spacer-level colony! Features All furniture retains mostly vanilla-like performance except for appearance. Some items emit light or offer small conveniences, but they require additional materials or power to keep balance intact. This mod can be safely added to an ongoing save. DLC & Requirements Works without any DLC. If Adaptive Storage Framework is active, storage-related items will appear much cleaner and more organized (functionality remains unchanged). If Biotech is active, a baby crib will be added. Guidelines This mod is distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0) license. name: ReBuild: Doors and Corners
author: Helixien, Oracle of Thessia
description: ReBuild is another mod in my series of vanilla friendly enhancements for Rimworld, focusing on adding content that should or could have been added by Ludeon themselves. Like always it is my main priority to make sure the content fits vanilla Rimworld, not just in art and design, but also how it is integrated and works hand in hand with vanilla features. Doors and Corners, the name being a reference to The Expanse, is the first module focusing on expanding the options you have for building your base. From new walls, to door, floors, retextures and overhauls. ReBuild is designed to be as lightweight as possible, adding the minimum of new code required for its additions to work.

name: Reel's Expanded Storage
description: !!! Requires Adaptive Storage Framework !!! !!! Requires Vanilla Furniture Expanded: Props and Decor !!! !!! IF LINKABLES ARE CRASHING YOUR GAME, UPDATE PERFORMANCE FISH !!! Welcome to Reel's Expanded Storage! Yep, another storage mod. The goal behind this one is to give functionality to many of the already existing Vanilla Expanded Props, while also offering decent stack sizes, a wide variety of options and included functionality to existing linkables including Vanilla Expanded mods, all under the Adaptive Storage Framework! One day, I decided to make a local patch of Phaneron's basic storage, with the intention of buffing the stack sizes and throwing in some structures from JangoD'Soul's Simple Storage. Then I thought, "Hey, there's all these unused textures in VE Props, why don't I give them some storage capabilities while creating some new original storage buildings I could really use myself?" Then SirHumphreyAppleby approached me and offered to patch many of the existing linkable benches to be able to store items... And so we got to work, which has resulted in this mod! If you're a fan of the faithful Vanilla Artstyle from Vanilla Expanded, or if you enjoyed high stack size storage mods like Simple Storage but wanted something a little toned down, or even wanted linkable functionality for structures like Dressers or Cabinets... This is the mod for you. And who knows? I might even update this in the future with new structures. Personally, I'm waiting for OwlChemist to update his freezer mod. Until then, I hope you enjoy! This mod currently adds 28 new storage buildings and 4 new tiers of research, that unlocks new storage options as you play through the game. The stack sizes may be generous at first, but it's built around vanilla stack sizes in mind. Of course, playing with higher stack mods like OgreStack will completely destroy the balance, whether you choose to do that is completely up to you. Building cost and construction time is a factor when it comes to balance, I highly encourage you to build multiple storage structures to get the most out of the experience.

name: Security Clearance
author: maevi
description: Yet another door locking mod for all your [DATA EXPUNGED] needs, heavily inspired by Card Doors. Adds several types and clearance levels of keycards, and makes it possible to restrict any powered door (i.e. autodoors, security doors) to a specific level. More specifically, it adds: - Five "standard" clearance levels of Alpha through Epsilon, each of which can unlock doors with its own clearance level or below (e.g. a Gamma keycard can unlock Gamma, Delta and Epsilon doors). - Four "special" clearance levels of Theta, Lambda, Tau, and Phi, each of which can only unlock its own associated door (e.g. only a Theta keycard can unlock a Theta door). - And last but not least an Omega clearance level, which can unlock everything. Omega clearance doors can only be unlocked with Omega keycards. Source code: https://codeberg.org/maevi/rimworld-mods/src/branch/main/security-clearance

name: Simply More Bridges (Continued)
author: Lanilor
description: [img]https://img.litet.net/logos/Info.png[/img] Update of Lanilors mod https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1420241138 [b]The release of RimWorld 1.6 added improved support for [url=https://github.com/emipa606/AssetBuilder/blob/main/README.md]Asset Bundles[/url][/b]. This is a limitation in the game and nothing I can change[/h2] - Splitted up the research-requirements for the bridges to make it more compatible with medival playthroughs. - Added an option to generate bridges from all materials, even from other mods. - Also wooden bridges will be generated from all woody materials. - Added option to build bridges using other visuals; Flagstone, Paved tile and Concrete-visuals. - Added russian translation, thanks Uncle Shvya - Added slider to set the cost of the bridges - All bridges (except Flagstone) are now considered Floor for Royalty - All bridges built from beautiful material (Gold/Jade etc.) are considered Fine Floor - Added french translation, thanks qux! - All bridges should now inherit the beauty-value from the material they are made of [img]https://img.litet.net/logos/Notice.png[/img] [table] [tr] [td][url=https://discord.gg/h5TY6DA][img]https://img.litet.net/logos/Discord.png[/img][/url][/td] [td][url=https://github.com/emipa606/SimplyMoreBridges][img]https://img.litet.net/logos/Github.png[/img][/url][/td] [/tr] [tr] [td][img]https://img.litet.net/logos/SafeToAdd.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://img.litet.net/logos/RemoveMayWork.png[/img][/td] [/tr] [/table] [img]https://img.litet.net/logos/OriginalDescription.png[/img] [h1]New bridges types for heavy structure support and building in deep water![/h1] A simple mod that adds more briges types on top of the wood bridges that rimworld core provides.
